name: New Relic
description: New Relic's hosted server runs NRQL, reads entities and alerts and helps investigate incidents.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (oauth2.service.newrelic.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
